description: 帮我使用html画一个鹈鹕骑自行车的svg动画

arguments.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>鹈鹕骑自行车</title>
<style>
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#0b2a4a;}
  svg{display:block;width:100vw;height:100vh;}

  /* 轮子旋转：绕自身中心 */
  .wheel-spin{
    transform-box: fill-box;
    transform-origin: center;
    animation: spin 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spin{ to{ transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  /* 曲柄组：绕(560,560)旋转 */
  .cranks{
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 560px 560px;
    animation: spin 1.2s linear infinite;
  }

  /* 腿：大腿绕髋(545,455)，小腿绕膝(545,550) */
  .thigh{
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 545px 455px;
    animation: thigh 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  .shin{
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 545px 550px;
    animation: shin 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes thigh{
    0%   { transform: rotate(-82.07deg); }
    25%  { transform: rotate(-37.60deg); }
    50%  { transform: rotate(-32.89deg); }
    75%  { transform: rotate(-90.75deg); }
    100% { transform: rotate(-82.07deg); }
  }
  @keyframes shin{
    0%   { transform: rotate(14.69deg); }
    25%  { transform: rotate(26.89deg); }
    50%  { transform: rotate(74.60deg); }
    75%  { transform: rotate(57.35deg); }
    100% { transform: rotate(14.69deg); }
  }

  /* 头/尾轻摆 */
  .head-bob{
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 640px 330px;
    animation: headbob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes headbob{
    from{ transform: rotate(-3deg); }
    to  { transform: rotate(3deg); }
  }
  .tail-bob{
    transform-box: view-box;
    transform-origin: 470px 430px;
    animation: tailbob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes tailbob{
    from{ transform: rotate(2deg); }
    to  { transform: rotate(-2deg); }
  }

  /* 鹈鹕整体上下轻晃 */
  .pelican{
    animation: bob 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes bob{
    0%,100%{ transform: translateY(0); }
    50%    { transform: translateY(6px); }
  }

  /* 路面虚线滚动 */
  .road-dash{
    animation: road 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes road{
    from{ transform: translateX(0); }
    to  { transform: translateX(-80px); }
  }

  /* 风吹线条 */
  .wind{
    opacity:0;
    animation: wind 1.5s linear infinite;
  }
  .wind.w2{ animation-delay: 0.5s; }
  .wind.w3{ animation-delay: 1.0s; }
  @keyframes wind{
    0%   { opacity:0; transform: translateX(0); }
    20%  { opacity:0.9; }
    100% { opacity:0; transform: translateX(-260px); }
  }

  /* 云漂移 */
  .cloud1{ animation: cloud1 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  .cloud2{ animation: cloud2 12s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
  @keyframes cloud1{ from{ transform: translateX(0);} to{ transform: translateX(60px);} }
  @keyframes cloud2{ from{ transform: translateX(0);} to{ transform: translateX(-80px);} }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg viewBox="0 0 1280 800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%"  stop-color="#8fd3ff"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#cfeaff"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#eaf7ff"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ground" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7ec96e"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#5aa850"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- 天空 -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="1280" height="800" fill="url(#sky)"/>

  <!-- 太阳 -->
  <circle cx="1120" cy="110" r="58" fill="#ffe08a"/>
  <circle cx="1120" cy="110" r="78" fill="#ffe08a" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- 云 -->
  <g class="cloud1" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9">
    <ellipse cx="240" cy="140" rx="70" ry="34"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="120" rx="55" ry="30"/>
    <ellipse cx="180" cy="125" rx="45" ry="26"/>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud2" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.85">
    <ellipse cx="820" cy="90" rx="60" ry="28"/>
    <ellipse cx="870" cy="75" rx="45" ry="24"/>
    <ellipse cx="775" cy="80" rx="40" ry="22"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 地面 -->
  <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="160" fill="url(#ground)"/>

  <!-- 路面 -->
  <rect x="0" y="640" width="1280" height="34" fill="#4a4a55"/>
  <g class="road-dash" stroke="#f4f4f4" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="40 40">
    <line x1="-80" y1="657" x2="1360" y2="657"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 风吹线条 -->
  <g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line class="wind w1" x1="180" y1="360" x2="300" y2="360"/>
    <line class="wind w2" x1="150" y1="430" x2="290" y2="430"/>
    <line class="wind w3" x1="170" y1="500" x2="280" y2="500"/>
  </g>

  <!-- 自行车 + 鹈鹕 整体 -->
  <g class="pelican">

    <!-- 后轮 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="380" cy="600" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="10"/>
      <g class="wheel-spin">
        <g stroke="#555" stroke-width="4">
          <line x1="380" y1="505" x2="380" y2="695"/>
          <line x1="285" y1="600" x2="475" y2="600"/>
          <line x1="313" y1="533" x2="447" y2="667"/>
          <line x1="313" y1="667" x2="447" y2="533"/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <circle cx="380" cy="600" r="10" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 前轮 -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="760" cy="600" r="95" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="10"/>
      <g class="wheel-spin">
        <g stroke="#555" stroke-width="4">
          <line x1="760" y1="505" x2="760" y2="695"/>
          <line x1="665" y1="600" x2="855" y2="600"/>
          <line x1="693" y1="533" x2="827" y2="667"/>
          <line x1="693" y1="667" x2="827" y2="533"/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <circle cx="760" cy="600" r="10" fill="#333"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车架（红色五根线） -->
    <g stroke="#e33" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="380" y1="600" x2="560" y2="560"/>
      <line x1="380" y1="600" x2="500" y2="430"/>
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="505" y2="415"/>
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="700" y2="420"/>
      <line x1="505" y1="430" x2="700" y2="420"/>
      <line x1="700" y1="420" x2="760" y2="600"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 车座 -->
    <path d="M470 415 q35 -22 70 0" fill="none" stroke="#222" stroke-width="14" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- 车把 -->
    <line x1="700" y1="420" x2="740" y2="370" stroke="#222" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="740" cy="370" r="9" fill="#111"/>

    <!-- 曲柄组（绕560,560旋转，踏板半径55） -->
    <g class="cranks">
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="615" y2="560" stroke="#333" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <line x1="560" y1="560" x2="505" y2="560" stroke="#333" stroke-width="8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <ellipse cx="615" cy="560" rx="16" ry="9" fill="#222"/>
      <ellipse cx="505" cy="560" rx="16" ry="9" fill="#222"/>
      <circle cx="560" cy="560" r="11" fill="#444"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 鹈鹕 -->
    <!-- 尾羽 -->
    <g class="tail-bob">
      <path d="M470 430 L400 400 L420 445 Z" fill="#eaf3ff" stroke="#bcd6f0" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 身体：底边y=470压住座面 -->
    <path d="M470 470
             Q455 410 500 385
             Q560 355 625 385
             Q675 410 665 470
             Q560 500 470 470 Z"
          fill="#f4faff" stroke="#bcd6f0" stroke-width="4"/>

    <!-- 翅膀手臂：从肩(600,395)前伸，手握车把弯头(740,370) -->
    <path d="M600 395 Q680 360 740 370" fill="none" stroke="#e4f0fc" stroke-width="20" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="740" cy="370" r="13" fill="#f4faff" stroke="#bcd6f0" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- 头：(665,278) r42 + 喙 + 喉囊 -->
    <g class="head-bob">
      <line x1="620" y1="380" x2="655" y2="305" stroke="#f4faff" stroke-width="24" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="665" cy="278" r="42" fill="#f4faff" stroke="#bcd6f0" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- 眼睛 -->
      <circle cx="682" cy="268" r="6" fill="#222"/>
      <!-- 喙 -->
      <path d="M700 278 L780 292 L700 300 Z" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#d98a12" stroke-width="3"/>
      <!-- 喉囊（鹈鹕标志） -->
      <path d="M700 298 Q745 340 782 300 Q740 322 700 298 Z" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#d98a12" stroke-width="3"/>
    </g>

    <!-- 腿：大腿(545,455)->膝(545,550)长95；小腿->脚(545,645)长95 -->
    <g class="thigh">
      <line x1="545" y1="455" x2="545" y2="550" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="18" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g class="shin">
        <line x1="545" y1="550" x2="545" y2="645" stroke="#f5a623" stroke-width="15" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <ellipse cx="545" cy="648" rx="18" ry="9" fill="#f5a623" stroke="#d98a12" stroke-width="3"/>
      </g>
    </g>

  </g>
</svg>
</body>
</html>
